purpose: Technical review packet with separate machine checks and independent mathematical reports

layout.review-plan.json: Precommitted claims, Coordinator prior, scoped joints, attacks, controls and exact producer hashes
layout.checker-plan.json: Equivalent assignments in the existing independence-checker schema; local reviewer IDs belong to archival task T-995
layout.blind-statement.md: Mathematical definition given to the blind reviewer, without producer proof methods or predicted degree values
layout.snapshot-manifest.json: Absolute permitted input locations and SHA256 hashes for immutable reviewer snapshots
layout.filtered-supplement.json: Separately committed one-case raw input/source/factor supplement, following the reviewer's initial missing-data finding
layout.machine/LefschetzBoundary.lean: Exact source containing eight arithmetic declarations checked freshly
layout.machine/*.lean.txt: Deliberate compiler/audit control source text; not ordinary proof modules
layout.machine/*.log: Full fresh compiler and axiom logs, including expected failures
layout.machine/verification.json: Exact named declarations, toolchain and binary hash, six control outcomes and explicit trust boundary
layout.machine/raw-archive-manifest.json: Original filenames and hashes in the immutable machine.tar.gz archive
layout.machine/published-manifest.json: Published file mapping, with control source extensions changed to .lean.txt without altering their bytes
layout.reviewers/TASK-*/: Each reviewer's report, attestation and any separately preserved check implementation/logs
layout.independence-check.log: Existing checker result on the plan and exact reviewer attestations; checks declarations rather than authenticating isolation
layout.claim-status.json: Per-claim machine status, independent mathematical findings, dependencies and next actions
layout.report.pdf: Inspected technical report with proof-dependency diagram
layout.reviewer-custody.json: Full raw reviewer archive, hash, restoration and exact restored-binary replay scope
layout.synthesis.md: Coordinator synthesis after receiving all reports; concrete degrees, dependencies and deviations
layout.dependencies.svg: Proof dependency diagram; not a measured-performance plot
layout.render-report.py: Metadata-only rendering script for the report and diagram
layout.packet-manifest.json: Hashes of all packet files except this manifest itself
layout.reviewers/TASK-N83-FILTERED/workflow-dev: Preserved noncompliant historical attempts; not accepted replay evidence

preservation: Producer records remain immutable. Supplements and corrections are separate records. Failed or noncompliant attempts are retained with their execution provenance.
units: Ordinary polynomial total degree with generator degree shifts; auxiliary monomial-order weights are a separate convention
